introHtml: Full color custom eye masks let you print logos, photos, or detailed designs across the entire fabric. Unlike single-stitch imprints, full-color sublimation or direct print captures gradients and fine text without fading. These masks are ideal for sleep kits, wellness swag, or hospitality giveaways where a vibrant, all-over design makes an impact. Choose a soft fabric like the Rest and Relax mask for comfort and vivid color reproduction.
heroAltText: Custom full color eye masks with vibrant printed design on soft fabric
